title: Employee Sub Group Commissions — Create / Edit
overviewHtml: The commission wagetypes of a grade. The average-commission wagetype pays one twelfth of what the employee earned on these wagetypes over the twelve months up to the pay date.

fields.label: WageType
fields.html:
What it is. A wagetype that counts as commission.

Example. Sales Commission

Why it matters. Each wagetype can be listed once per grade.
